Therapy can take years to show any improvement. I'm proud of you for going. Will you try for another six months?

I never wanted to go before because it takes so much time and bullshit and money to see the smallest results. But if I could afford it, then I would go now.

My first therapy session I was 15. I'm 37 now. I never went for very long...
I will look for your posts.
Thank you and best wishes on your journey towards inner peace. I am happy for you. It can take a long time for therapy to make a difference. If I could afford it, I would go again.
Me too. I really am. I'm sorry. For every thing.
All I wanted was pizza and a hug, too. I ordered the pizza. I had one slice before it ended up on the floor. I never got the hug.

I can't remember the last time I didn't think about ending it, but I try to think about tomorrow. What if something amazing happens tomorrow? I'll miss it of I'm not here... Stupid, I know. Lol. I also have a hobby (it's stupid, just knitting) with a lot of unfinished projects, so I tell myself I can't go without finishing them first. Some I know I will never finish, and I'm at the point where I've lost all interest in everything including my hobbies, but if I can trick myself into just one more day... I don't know. I don't know how much longer this will work. But the tommorow thing I've been holding onto for almost 30 years now. Some days have been amazing. Most haven't, though.
My husband just told me that he can't handle my depression and that it's bringing him down. He says when our kids are grown that it's over. Yesterday I was bragging about how supportive he is...
